newsitem.title: UK: Seton to take on Hoechst UK OTCs.
newsitem.headline: Seton to take on Hoechst UK OTCs.

text.p: Britain's Seton Healthcare Group Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed that Hoechst Marion Roussel Ltd, the UK subsidiary of Hoechst AG, would transfer its OTC product portfolio to Seton.

It said in a statement that under the terms of the 10 year agreement, it would be responsible for the sales and marketing from May 1, in the UK and Eire of the headache treatment Syndol and the Merocaine range of medicated throat lozenges.
Seton will pay 2.4 million stg for "know-how" over the first two years of the agreement and a percentage of the sales achieved during the period of the agreement.
